messages:
support_jen: Heads-up — QuickCart opened a support ticket: p99 for /v1/generate jumped ~2.5x between 03:14–03:22 UTC. They also saw a few 500s. They say it started after a release but logs show a lot of auth proxy retries.
sre_alex: Repro steps from customer? can we get trace ids?
support_jen: They attached two traces and a screenshot of our dashboard. Trace ids: trace-0a1, trace-0a2. I uploaded logs to the case.
eng_infra_maya: I pulled traces — I see a pattern: auth proxy returns 401, client retries, succeeding request later. Each retry looks like a full API request in metrics. That can inflate tail.
observability_bot: Noted. Dashboard panel query currently:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="api", route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
```
This omits the `sum(...) by (le)` aggregation. That could produce wrong quantiles when scraped from multiple instances.
pm_tomas: Wait — our dashboard had a recent change to switch panel mode to "instant" with 1m step for the time range. Could both the missing aggregation + short step explain the bump?
sre_alex: Yes — two problems: (1) query wrong (no sum by le), (2) retries create extra high-latency events. Together they move the apparent 99th.
dev_javier: Quick experiment suggestion: rerun the corrected query and then filter out retry-labeld requests. e.g. add `{auth_retry!="true"}` if proxy labels retries.
eng_infra_maya: I ran both queries on prod metrics for that window:
```
# current (bad)
histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="api",route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
# corrected
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="api",route="/v1/generate",auth_retry!="true"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Result: bad query shows p99 ~ 820ms. corrected & excluding retries shows p99 ~ 310ms. Corrected with retries included (but using sum by le) ~ 480ms.
oncall_bot: Annotation: created incident marker on dashboard for 03:14–03:22 UTC.
support_jen: Customer insists it started after their deploy. Did anything change related to auth retries?
eng_infra_maya: We rolled auth-proxy config 03:12 UTC to enable optimistic token refresh for new clients — it added a brief extra 401+retry behavior for clients that send expired tokens. That explains why retries spiked.
sre_alex: Root cause hypothesis: client library sends request, token refresh path triggers a short 401 then the client retries transparently. Our metric labels currently don't distinguish client retries vs first attempts, so dashboards count both equally.
pm_tomas: For mitigation: can we (A) fix the panel query to sum by (le) immediately? (B) add `{auth_retry!="true"}` label on the proxy so dashboards can exclude retries, and (C) revert optimistic token refresh until we add a retry label?
dev_javier: I can push a small change in the proxy to add `auth_retry="true"` to retry requests within 30min. Non-breaking and quick.
eng_infra_maya: I'll update the dashboards to use the corrected query and add a temp panel showing `excluding retries`.
sre_alex: Short-term mitigation: update the SLO calc to use corrected quantiles (sum by le) and exclude retries for p95/p99 SLO evaluation until we have a better client rollout.
oncall_bot: Patch request assigned to dev_javier (#INC-7382).
support_jen: Tell customer: we identified a transient retry pattern because of proxy change; we're deploying fixes and updating dashboards to remove retry noise. Will follow up in ticket. :thumbsup:
sre_alex: Postmortem actions: (1) label retries in metrics, (2) dashboard query sanity check (lint on PRs), (3) change SLO tooling to ignore `auth_retry` for quantile calculations unless explicitly included.
pm_tomas: Also add a note in release docs when auth-proxy config toggles that might change visible retries.
support_jen: Customer updated ticket: thanks, they see p99 back to normal after our revert to old proxy config and dashboard fix. Closing loop. :relieved:
